groups.name: PTY lifecycle and readiness
groups.reason: Dynamic terminal membership, readiness-only reactor, backpressure and owned shutdown. UiApp also exposes one post-build decoration seam shared by compiled and reloaded markup, keeping native chrome motion consistent in development.
tests: npm test: terminal and application lifecycle regressions
npm test: chrome_tests compiled/reloaded view decoration

groups.name: Native frame scheduling and raster policy
groups.reason: Demand-driven display-link pacing on macOS 14+, common-mode timer fallback, actual display refresh rates, opt-in drawable presentation timestamps, and bounded retained-surface caching/presentation. Translation-only raster reuse preserves paint/text/opacity/clip semantics, refreshes settled content, and supports HiDPI surfaces within a fixed 64 MiB total cache budget.
tests: Actual presentedTime cadence and native-window smoke

groups.name: Canvas terminal painting and appearance
groups.reason: Terminal-grid paint/cache behavior and application token compatibility. Modal backdrop painting is independent of native scrollbar occlusion.

groups.name: Retained canvas motion
groups.reason: Paint-only poses and retained split movement avoid source rebuilds, text layout and accessibility publication on intermediate animation frames. Updates are validated before mutation and can be batched into one display-list emission.
